<style>.mag{border:0;cursor:pointer;font:700 15px Inter,sans-serif;color:#fff;background:var(--accent,#3366FF);
 padding:16px 32px;border-radius:14px;transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}</style>
<button class="mag" id="mag">Book a call</button>
<script>
const b=document.getElementById('mag');
b.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();
 b.style.transform='translate('+((e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)*.3)+'px,'+((e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)*.4)+'px)';});
b.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>b.style.transform='');
</script>
